question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Impelled
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Irresolute.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"impelled"** means driven to take action or compelled to do something. (प्रेरित करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She was impelled by her passion for justice to become a lawyer.
 
 
 
• **"Irresolute"** refers to someone who is uncertain or indecisive, unable to make decisions quickly. (दुविधाग्रस्त)
 
 
• **Example:** The irresolute manager could not decide on the best course of action for the project.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"impelled"** is **"irresolute"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Irresolute**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Limelight** (चर्चा में रहना): The center of public attention.

 
 
• **Example:** The actor's performance put him in the limelight overnight.
 
 
 
• **Allure** (आकर्षण): The quality of being powerfully and mysteriously attractive or fascinating.
 
 
• **Example:** The allure of the beautiful landscape drew many tourists to the region.
 
 
 
• **Agape** (मुंह खोले हुए): With the mouth wide open, especially in surprise or wonder.
 
 
• **Example:** The children stood agape as the magician pulled a rabbit out of his hat.
